rule: A visual discovery never promotes a scientific contact. established/bounded/proposed/open describe the scientific ledger; visitor discovery is a separate UI state.

contacts.question: Can exact response-signature discrimination become a practical sequential observation problem?
contacts.closure_condition: Map MRM response signatures, probe grammar and costs into MROD admissible regions and candidate-outcome partitions, then verify preservation of the declared mechanism distinctions.

contacts.question: Can target-resolution design and mechanism-resolution design share one decision object?
contacts.closure_condition: Use one contract linking CED-safe unresolved target classes and MROD mechanism/state regions to the same candidate observations, risks and costs.

contacts.question: Can disagreement among compatible biogeographic worlds be converted to a value-ranked next-observation problem?
contacts.closure_condition: Define an adapter from surviving EOG world support/disagreement to MROD outcome partitions and show sequential contraction without relabeling world identity as causal truth.

contacts.question: Does information-selected observation resolve real physical observer ambiguity?
contacts.closure_condition: Freeze candidate measurements/interventions prospectively, obtain independent exposure or biological truth, and score held-out contraction against a frozen comparator in the same physical system.

contacts.question: Can required state and evidence licensing be tested together in one natural system?
contacts.closure_condition: Synchronize candidate state variables, observation/evidence contract and an independently held-out future endpoint; test state adequacy before residual origin/history.

contacts.question: Does measured future-relevant relational state condition architecture payoff coordinates?
contacts.closure_condition: In one matched model or natural system, measure relational state before payoff quantities and demonstrate the context mapping without treating either programme as validation of the other.

contacts.question: Does architecture differentiation generate a different relational eco-genetic state and future functional vulnerability?
contacts.closure_condition: Measure or manipulate architecture state, quantify the resulting interaction/relational state, then score subsequent future function on the same scale/system.

contacts.question: Do contrasting fragmentation histories become predictively equivalent after conditioning on a future-relevant joint state?
contacts.closure_condition: Measure candidate state before outcome, predict an independent future endpoint, then test whether origin/history adds residual predictive information. This closes state convergence only, not warning validation.

contacts.question: Do bounded candidate patches improve prospective field evidence collection?
contacts.closure_condition: Survey frozen candidate patches and matched comparators with explicit effort and detectability denominators; score enrichment/efficiency rather than guaranteed presence or detection.

contacts.question: Do independently fitted role-specific ecological answers satisfy a prospectively frozen external biological relation?
contacts.closure_condition: Predeclare role-specific estimands and accessible areas, freeze a common relation-space adapter and external biological relation, then test on independent cross-role opportunities. Same-target cross-source feasibility alone is insufficient.

bounded_receipts.receipt: 284b explicitly defines cross-estimand biological validity in a frozen common relation space and documents implementation/results/tests; it is no longer an empty staging seed.

The frozen 36-taxon panel yielded 36 current-taxonomy-resolved -> 12 snapshot-identity-resolved -> 12 source-mode-sampling-passed; this permits model construction for 12 taxa but cannot create the predeclared >=30-taxon calibration ceiling and does not establish ecological-answer coherence.
Validated claim remains candidate-patch enrichment under its frozen screening contract, not occupancy or guaranteed detection.
Natural-data measurement/representation adequacy can be assessed independently of finite EGWE warning-statistic validation.
